gold.summary: Bare 'Cached ForwardMsg MISS' report, no version or context.

missing_info.why: older than 1.45.1 -> known fixed bug; newer -> new/residual issue to escalate

missing_info.item: deployment platform (local / Community Cloud / Streamlit in Snowflake)

acceptable_next_steps: Ask exact Streamlit version and deployment platform.
Ask when the error occurs and whether a minimal app reproduces it; mention older fixes conditionally.
must_not: ask a full fixed checklist (OS, browser, python) without saying why
claim it is fixed without knowing the version
gold.reference: Maintainer asked for the version; closed as likely caused by an old version.
gold.review_reason: Only the cache error is given. Ask version and platform to distinguish old fixed bugs from newer variants.

acceptable_next_steps: Ask for the exact Streamlit version first; if < 1.46 recommend upgrade
Mention the known fix (1.45.1 / 1.46.0 cache cleanup) conditionally
